title: UK Clearing Advisor - scraper freshness & health (clearing-2026.mehrs.net)

panels.title: At a glance - is the scraper running and is data fresh?
Scraper runs (last 1h)
panels.description: AWS/Lambda Invocations for uk-clearing-advisor-2027-DailyScraper. During Clearing this should be non-zero every hour (>=2/h in the 30-min phase, ~6/h in the 10-min peak phase). 0 = the scraper is NOT running on schedule.

panels.title: DLQ messages (delivery failures)
panels.description: AWS/SQS ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible for uk-clearing-advisor-2027-scraper-schedule-dlq. 0 = healthy. >0 = one or more scheduled triggers could not be delivered to the scraper Lambda after retries.

panels.title: Lambda errors (last 1h)
panels.description: AWS/Lambda Errors for the scraper. NOTE: a known Node 22 undici teardown AssertionError currently fires on some invocations AFTER the scrape completes, so a small non-zero value here does not necessarily mean data is stale - cross-check the 'Recent scrape runs' table below, which shows whether each run actually completed.

panels.title: Scraper invocation history
panels.description: Invocations vs Errors over time. Invocations should form a regular cadence matching the EventBridge Scheduler phase.

panels.title: Scraper duration
panels.description: How long each scrape run takes (ms). A sudden climb can indicate slow/timing-out university sites.

panels.title: Scrape quality per run (universities not cleanly refreshed)
panels.description: From the scraper's own 'scrape complete' log line. 'unreachable' + 'blocked' + 'errors' are the count of universities (out of ~44) whose page did not refresh cleanly on that run - i.e. their displayed data is comparatively staler than the rest.

targets.expression: filter msg = "scrape complete" | stats max(unreachable) as unreachable, max(blocked) as blocked, max(errors) as errors by bin(30m)

panels.title: DLQ depth over time
panels.description: Undelivered scheduled triggers captured in the dead-letter queue. Should stay flat at 0.

panels.title: Recent scrape runs (freshness + per-run outcome)
panels.description: The most recent scraper runs from the 'scrape complete' log line. The top row's timestamp is the time of the last successful scrape. checked=universities processed, changes=status changes detected, errors/unreachable/blocked=universities that did not refresh cleanly.

targets.expression: fields @timestamp, checked, changes, errors, unreachable, blocked | filter msg = "scrape complete" | sort @timestamp desc | limit 30

panels.title: How to read this dashboard / data notes

options.content:
**Is the data fresh?** The scraper scans **every** university on every run (`count = checked = 44`), so all universities are refreshed together - the age of the newest data equals the time since the last successful run (top row of *Recent scrape runs*). The exceptions are the `unreachable` / `blocked` / `errors` universities on a given run: those specific pages did not refresh that cycle, so their data is as old as the last run where they succeeded.

**Per-university age is not a live panel here.** The scraper records per-university freshness (`lastAutomatedCheck`, `clearingPageStatus`) in **DynamoDB only** - it is not emitted as a per-university CloudWatch metric or log line, and Grafana's CloudWatch datasource cannot read DynamoDB attributes. To get a true per-university age panel, the scraper must emit a per-provider metric or log line (small code change + redeploy).

**Two known issues surfaced while building this:** (1) the scraper's custom `ClearingAdvisor` metrics (`ScraperRunCount` etc.) are **not being recorded** - `PutMetricData` is failing silently, most likely a missing `cloudwatch:PutMetricData` IAM permission on the Lambda role; this dashboard therefore uses `AWS/Lambda` metrics + Logs Insights instead. (2) Some invocations hit a Node 22 **undici `AssertionError`** on socket teardown *after* the scrape completes, which inflates the Lambda `Errors` metric even though the run finished - hence cross-checking the *Recent scrape runs* table.

Data source: region `eu-west-1`, scraper `uk-clearing-advisor-2027-DailyScraper`, DLQ `uk-clearing-advisor-2027-scraper-schedule-dlq`.
